`2021 – 2024`

**Topics:** LNG · thermal power · environmental, social & health impact assessment

**Skills used:** IFC Performance Standards, ADB Safeguard Policies, environmental fieldwork, GIS

## Overview

Environmental, Social and Health Impact Assessment (ESHIA) for the **Bac Lieu 3,200 MW LNG-to-Power project** in Bac Lieu Province, Vietnam, developed by **Delta Offshore Energy**.

## My role

- Supervised environmental fieldwork across water, soil, air, noise and biodiversity
- Authored the **Environmental Baseline** chapter covering climatic, hydrological and topographical site conditions
- Authored ESIA/ESMP chapters on surface water, groundwater, air, noise and soil impacts
